comparison.objective: Hold a sock on a line, open a clothespin, clip it over sock and line, then release the sock.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization plus spring-jaw squeezing and latching; no hammer-driven fracture or small loose-part recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Clothespin clamps the sock to the line before the sock is released. Wind and retention thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shared two-hand stabilization is generic; the mechanism and outcome are spring clipping and retention, not destructive insert finishing.
